checks.finding: Requirements REQ-001 through REQ-006 and acceptance criteria AC-001 through AC-014 define concrete actor boundaries (SDD Core, Capabilities, Provider Bindings, Host Adapters), explicit consumer dispositions (KEEP, PARAMETERIZE, EXTRACT, DEFER), operational consent states (per-feature, standing, off), and unambiguous verification result states (PASS, BLOCKED, not-applicable) with no conflicting interpretations.

No contradictions found across requirements, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and investigation findings; REQ-001 dispositions align with non-goals deferring cloud execution and promotion gates, and AC-003c/TEST-004 preserves legacy check requirements as BLOCKED pending approved migration without premature waiver.

Acceptance tests provide comprehensive coverage of negative and boundary paths: AC-005 covers no-project-context legacy fallback (TEST-005), AC-006 covers facet-hybrid layer retention on non-UI targets (TEST-006), AC-004 covers unavailable verifiers and not-run checks resulting in BLOCKED, AC-008e-g and AC-009a-b cover per-feature transient decline, standing single-audit, off no-upload fallback, and tool-unavailable fallback.

Investigation explicitly grounds all consumer claims against origin/main at commit 2b328e4050f6a2e3fbb647fc9530fcc55ac7ec70, verifies reuse of ADR-0016, ADR-0017, and ADR-0018 boundaries without reimplementation, and bounds future facet-native and check-vocabulary changes to explicitly versioned migrations.

Approval and governance boundaries are explicitly specified and testable: REQ-005 and AC-008e/f/g enforce fail-closed external upload consent with per-feature prompt/grant/withdrawal audit trails, REQ-002 protects Capability/Registry policy inputs, and AC-013 enforces ADR-0017 stage scoping preventing unapproved promotion stage emission.

The specification establishes complete ownership partitioning, disposition classifications for all 11 consumers, five concrete target examples (CLI/library, UI application, design-only, IaC/cloud, low-code), and comprehensive acceptance criteria without leaving product behavior decisions to downstream design review.

Project contains no domain/ directory or approved domain-contract.json; domain conformance check is satisfied as not applicable with no bounded-context contradictions or forbidden synonyms introduced in requirements or acceptance tests.
